correctness.rationale: The full frozen proof reconstructs the degree-one Dirichlet Gram inverse G^{-1}_{ij}=A(A+1)delta_ij/alpha_i-A and reproducing kernel K(x,y)=A(A+1)sum x_i y_i/alpha_i-A. Barycentric convexity and strict sign disagreement on a positive-measure neighborhood exclude nonvertices. Beta(a,A-a) marginal truncation gives exactly 1+2[A I_{a/(A+1)}(a,A-a)-(A+1)I_{a/(A+1)}(a+1,A-a)]. Conditional Jensen under Dirichlet(a,c-a,A-c) is strict across the kink, selecting only minimum-alpha vertices. The fixed-total sharp 1+2A envelope follows beta fractional moments, and the high-concentration Gaussian limit follows the beta CLT with uniform L2 bound; no finite test substitutes for these arguments.
